annotations.title: A vault’s tokenized stocks and stablecoins

description: What one vault holds in real-world assets: tokenized stocks it holds at its own address, what it has lent against tokenized stocks as collateral (exposure through borrowers, not stocks it owns), and whether its own asset is a stablecoin. Free. Holdings come from the registers we rebuild for the largest stock tokens; anything outside them is not seen, not absent: heldStatus not_indexed means unknown (heldUsd null), never zero. Stock collateral is placed by network, token contract and market, never by symbol alone where the contract is known; a market naming a stock token that is not counted is listed in excludedMarkets with its reason. SINCE 2026-11-27 READ stocks.coverageStatus FIRST: not_read (no market of the vault was read: lentAgainstUsd null, whether it lends against stocks cannot be determined), partial (knownLentAgainstUsd over the markets read, with coverage.marketsRead and coverage.uncoveredCapitalUsd) or complete. A zero is a finding only where complete.
